## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Style foundations

- Visual style: high-contrast, artistic
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/18/24/30/36 | Fonts: primary=Limelight,
  display=Limelight, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600,
  700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#3B82F6, secondary=#8B5CF6, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, professional, action-oriented.

## Design intent

High-contrast, expressive style with creative typography and bold color choices
for visually striking interfaces.
